annotations.title: Get the tax and social filing calendar of Algeria

description: Get the legal filing and payment deadlines of businesses in Algeria, each with who must file, the deadline as the text words it, its article and the official text it was read in (the 2026 tax codes of the Directorate General of Taxes, the CNAS and CASNOS sites): the monthly VAT return and payment (G50, within the first 20 days of each month, CTCA art. 76-1), withholding taxes (by the 20th, monthly or quarterly, CIDTA art. 129-1), the IFU forecast return G12 and the IFU minimum (by 30 June), the IFU payment in full or in instalments (50 %, then 1-15 September and 1-15 December), the IFU final return G12 bis (by 20 January of the next year), the annual profit return (by 30 April), the annual summary statement ERA (before 30 September), the annual IRG return (by 30 June), the penalty for an annual return not filed (25 %, 35 % after a formal notice), the CNAS contributions (within 30 days of each quarter or month), the CNAS annual declaration DAS (within 30 days of the year end) and affiliation (within 10 days of hiring), and the CASNOS annual contribution (before 30 June). A deadline on a legal holiday moves to the next working day. The yearly extensions decided by the DGI are not listed. Filters: q (words, accents ignored, e.g. "IFU" or "CNAS") and treatment (monthly, quarterly, annual, ifu, social, penalty, general). Algeria only (country DZ); other countries return country_not_available.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

q.description: Words that must all appear in the item (label, who, deadline, legal basis), accents and case ignored, for example G50, IFU, CNAS, 30 avril.

treatment.description: Only the obligations of this kind.
